name: French Onion Soup
description: A classic French onion soup made with caramelized onions, consomme, and topped with melted mozzarella cheese and croutons.
recipeIngredient: 4 Oxo cubes dissolved in 2 cups hot water

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter. Saute onions until transparent.
Add to Oxo, consomme and water. Simmer about 2 hours.
Put in onion soup bowls, add a slice of French bread on top of each one and add shredded mozzarella cheese sprinkled over each.
Put in oven at 350°F for 30 minutes.

keywords: French onion soup, caramelized onions, melted cheese

_similar.name: Cream of Cucumber Soup
_similar.description: A refreshing and creamy cucumber soup made with chicken broth, milk, and a hint of cayenne pepper.

recipeInstructions.text: In the microwave, cook onions and olive oil on High for 2 minutes.
Dice cucumbers and add to onions. Cook until soft.
Use a blender to purée the cucumbers (hand blender works well).
Mix the flour with ¼ cup chicken broth. Add to the cucumbers, along with the remaining chicken broth, cayenne, and nutmeg. Cook 6 to 8 minutes on High.
Add the milk and dill. Serve.

_similar.keywords: cucumber soup, creamy soup, refreshing soup
